name: frontend-designer
description: Create a concrete visual brief for a new or redesigned web UI, or compare rendered UI with its brief. Use for substantial design decisions; return a spec without editing application code.

name: frontend-builder
description: Implement scoped frontend changes and regression tests using the project stack and an agreed visual brief. Use for writing or fixing web UI; this is the team application-code writer.

name: frontend-code-reviewer
description: Review frontend diffs for concrete correctness, state, integration, security and maintenance defects. Use after a meaningful implementation or for explicit code review; report findings without changing code.

name: frontend-browser-qa
description: Verify the actual rendered web UI, responsive layouts and user journeys using available browser tools. Use after UI changes or for visual QA; report evidence without changing application code.

name: frontend-a11y-reviewer
description: Review changed web interactions for keyboard access, semantics, focus, names, contrast and assistive-technology behavior. Use for forms, dialogs, navigation and accessibility audits; report without changing code.

name: frontend-performance-reviewer
description: Investigate frontend performance using comparable bundle, browser, network or profiler evidence. Use for regressions, heavy pages or explicit performance work; recommend measured changes without editing code.
